final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS customer_count FROM store_counts), step3 AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.customer_count, s.customer_count * 1.0 / t.customer_count AS share FROM store_counts AS s CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.customer_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(customer_count) AS average_count FROM step3) SELECT s.store_id, s.customer_count, s.share, s.customer_count * 1.0 / a.average_count FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL
